//: Fill in "file" (path relative to assets/art/) as each sheet is delivered; null = not delivered (placeholder art is used). Each anim is one row of frames, left to right, in the order listed (row index given). Bump "version" whenever images change. Spec: docs/ART_HANDOFF.md

board.notes: The whole painted diorama, seen from the tilted camera. Paint over docs/art/board-template.png at exactly this size: water, sandy floor, the winding path, all 14 coral socket cups, the spawn cave at top-left, decorative clay coral/pebbles in the free space, the wooden/clay rail at the bottom. Do NOT paint towers, enemies, the Coral Heart or the fish (they are separate sprites). Keep the path and sockets exactly where the template puts them.

player.classic.notes: Tiny clay clownfish riding the rail, side view facing RIGHT (renderer mirrors it). Bubble-gun nozzle on top: Minus/Plus bubbles leave from the top center of the frame. shoot = quick squash (Minus), plus = bigger squash + happy face.

player.golden.notes: Unlockable skin: gold guppy. Same layout as player.classic.

player.neon.notes: Unlockable skin: neon tetra (blue body, red stripe). Same layout as player.classic.

player.galaxy.notes: Unlockable skin: galaxy betta (deep purple, star speckles). Same layout as player.classic.

boss.chef.notes: Chef Octopus (wave 5 boss): big purple octopus, apron, mustache, ladle. DRAW WITHOUT THE HAT — the hat is boss.chef.hat (it is the weak point and sways separately). Leave room at the top of the head. move2 = angrier phase-2 walk (optional). throw = lobs an ink bomb. summon = waves ladle, minis appear.

boss.chef.hat.notes: The tall puffy white chef hat. Anchor = bottom-center of the hat; it is placed on the chef's head at 90% of the chef sprite height and sways with the hitbox. Make it read as a target (slightly glowing/wobbly).

boss.sharky.notes: Sharky the Teething (wave 10): chubby baby shark with metal braces, drooling. windup = crouch + red-faced grr (telegraph!). charge = stretched mid-dash. stunned = seeing stars. recover = panting.

boss.queen.notes: Starfish Queen (wave 15): giant orange starfish with a gold crown and gems. closed = arms curled in, shield shards rotating around her (armored). open = arms flung wide, vulnerable belly showing (clearly different!). summon = star minions spawn.

boss.kitty.notes: Kraken Kitty (wave 20 final boss): giant pink kraken with cat ears, whiskers and huge cute eyes; many tentacles. swipe = paw swipe toward the rail. exposed = dizzy, belly up, sparkles (after Plus pops her purr shield). move2 = phase 2+.

boss.kitty.tentacle.notes: A Kraken Kitty tentacle wrapped around a tower socket (drawn over the tower). grip = squeezing loop. break = snaps and retracts (plays once).

heart.notes: The Coral Heart (what you defend): chunky pink brain-coral heart with a cute face. hit = flinch. low = worried/cracked (under 35% HP).
